footnote_text: On November 6, 2026, Roku, Inc. ("Roku" or the "Company") and Fox Corporation ("FOX") completed the transactions contemplated by the Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement"), dated as of June 14, 2026, by and among Roku, Fox, Falcon Merger Sub 1, Inc. ("Merger Sub 1") and Falcon Merger Sub 2, LLC ("Merger Sub 2") (the "Mergers"). Pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, each share of Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock (if any) of Roku (together, "Company Common Stock") held by the Reporting Person that was outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time (as defined in the Merger Agreement) was converted into the right to receive (A) 0.9799 shares of FOX Class A Common Stock (together with cash in lieu of fractional shares), without interest, and (B) $95.30 in cash, without interest (together, the "Merger Consideration").
